text:
evelyn: Quick sync — we need a decision on Q3 packaging/quota approach. Sales escalating several customers about hard vs soft overages and whether to enable burst credits by default. Need final by Thu EOD so legal/finance can finish contract language.

sam: Can you list the concrete options? I want to size engineering work.

evelyn: Three options on the table:
1) Strict quota enforcement: request beyond quota = 429 unless they have burst credits. Clear, low risk.
2) Soft overages: allow short grace period (24h) with usage email + bill at overage rate.
3) Auto-burst: system allows temporary bursts up to X% for a fee, tracked by sliding window and reconciled monthly.

mina: Customers prefer (3) but want predictable cost. They asked for per-route caps and per-team budgets.

jorge: Finance concerns: soft overages (2) raises churn/revenue unpredictability. Auto-burst (3) can be modeled with a surcharge and conservatively forecasted. Need expected uplift numbers.

lia: Legal note: any auto-burst needs change to TOS and billing disclosures. Also need refund policy for accidental bursts.

taylor: Engineering: Estimating infra work:
- 2w to add per-customer per-route quota metadata + enforcement hooks
- 1w to implement soft overage window + alerts
- 3w to build burst manager (sliding window counters, throttles, billing hooks)
Also need metrics (-cost): token-metered events, top offenders, and end-to-end tests.

sam: So rough effort: option1 = minimal (config + docs), option2 = +1w, option3 = +3-4w. Doable for Q3 if we prioritize.

evelyn: Launch criteria we should agree on (proposal):
- acceptance tests for enforcement paths
- billing reconciliation audit for last 30 days
- UI in console that shows current quota, consumed, and burst status
- contract language ready and legal signoff

mina: Sales must be able to toggle burst per account from console and via API.

taylor: API toggle is trivial once DB fields exist. UI + audit trail adds a week.

jorge: For revenue modeling, provide two flavors for auto-burst pricing:
A) Fixed surcharge: +20% on overage token cost during burst window
B) Premium bucket: sell X tokens of burst capacity per month at a discount vs on-demand
We can simulate both.

lia: For refunds: propose automatic one-time reversal if customer reports accidental burst within 48h and usage pattern flagged as anomaly. Legal approves as long as we log explicit opt-in/opt-out and provide clear invoices.

evelyn: Can we sketch the policy text for the console tooltip? Short blurb:
`Burst: temporarily allows usage beyond your quota. Additional charges apply. Toggle in Account settings.`

sam: Implementation note: enforcement should be policy-driven. We'll add policy table: {"enforcement_mode": [strict, soft, burst], "burst_pct": int, "grace_period_hours": int}

taylor: putting config example:
```
{
  "enforcement_mode": "burst",
  "burst_pct": 30,
  "grace_period_hours": 24,
  "per_route_caps": {
    "chat": 1000000,
    "embeddings": 500000
  }
}
```

mina: Sales request: allow per-route exemptions and a whitelist for strategic customers.

jorge: For forecasting, ask data science to run a 3-month simulation on current customers with burst_pct 20/30/50. I'll own it, need CSV of historical token usage.

evelyn: Action items:
- sam/taylor: produce engineering spike + final effort estimate by Tue (sam)
- jorge: run forecast sim by Wed
- lia: draft TOS addendum + refund policy by Wed
- mina: collect 3 customer asks and who wants auto-burst by Tue EOD
- evelyn: decide option and send to execs Thu morning

taylor: one risk: caching/batching behavior can amplify token usage during bursts. We'll add a load-shedding safelist and hard cap to avoid runaway costs.

sam: Also need observability: token-level tracing per account, and alert when projected monthly bill exceeds commit by 20%.

mina: +1 on alerts. Customers asked for daily burn reports during trial phases.

lia: Compliance: ensure we store audit logs for changes to burst toggle for 12 months.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/quotas spike -> staging on 1805002200, notify #eng-oncall.

evelyn: Consensus check: everyone OK with prioritizing option (3) Auto-burst as the default roadmap item, with strict hard cap fallback? Say :thumbsup: if yes.

sam: :thumbsup:

mina: :thumbsup:

jorge: :thumbsup:

lia: :thumbsup:

taylor: :thumbsup:

evelyn: Great. We'll run the spikes and reconvene Fri for a quick sync. Thanks all.
